Straight-on elevation of a 2000s Chinese riverside residential tower facade at night, Yichang, Hubei. Pale beige ceramic tile and grey concrete, a regular grid of dark aluminium windows, projecting balconies with air-conditioner units, some windows warm-lit and most dark, subtle rain streaks and grime, security grilles on the lower floors. No text, no signage, no shop names, no people, no bridge, no landscape. Flat orthographic view, even diffuse lighting, seamless tileable texture, high detail, photographic, muted teal-and-amber night grade, realistic ordinary Chinese apartment building.
